name: EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook (November 2026): world oil production, consumption and WTI price, Oct 2026 - Dec 2027
source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Short-Term Energy Outlook monthly workbook STEO_m.xlsx
license: public domain (U.S. Government work), attribution recommended
unit: million barrels per day (production/consumption); USD per barrel (WTI)
coverage: world crude oil production, world total liquids production, world total liquids consumption, WTI price; 2026-10 .. 2027-12 (15 months, 1 historical + 14 forecast); 60 rows
forecast_vintage: STEO November 2026 (modeling completed 2026-11-05); last historical month 2026-10; table beginning 2022-01
notes: Machine-readable slice of the public EIA STEO monthly workbook: four series rows (copr_world, papr_world, patc_world, WTIPUUS) extracted from sheets 3dtab/3atab/3etab/2tab for 2026-10..2027-12. status column marks 2026-10 as historical and later months as forecast (cutoff from the workbook's 'Last Historical Month' = 202610). Values are copied as published, not re-estimated. This is a single forecast vintage (November 2026), not a PIT/vintage archive and not a substitute for IEA WEO scenarios. Workbook is not committed; only this compact table is pinned. EIA is public domain (U.S. Government work), attribution recommended.
